newsitem.title: UK: BAe falls on French election result.
newsitem.headline: BAe falls on French election result.

text.p: Shares in British Aerospace Plc fell 12p to 1,243-1/2 after Sunday's French election result prompted fears over the privatisation of Thomson-CSF, analysts said.

The sudden strong performance of left wing parties in the first round of the National Assembly poll raised fears the privatisation of the defence electronics group may be delayed or cancelled, they added.
BAe has teamed up with Lagardere, which is one of two groups bidding for Thomson-CSF.
But some industry watchers believe the current worries over Thomson's privatisation were overdone.
They said any French government would see the necessity of privatisation to ensure the European defence industry would consolidate to cope with U.S. competition.
"Whoever is in government has to address the issue of Europe becoming competitive against the Americans," one said.
British Aerospace only reacted on Tuesday on the French election results as the London stock market was closed for a national holiday on Monday
